primary: For each seed and family, average over five strengths the target-rate difference (positive minus negative) divided by two on the same 100 published prompts. Average the five family responses equally. Compare SVD minus dictionary, with paired prompt resampling.
development_gates: Report point estimates and interval bounds against the frozen 10 percentage point SVD response and 5 point advantage. Call evidence strong only if the fixed aggregate lower 95% interval clears each threshold in both reused seeds and all descriptor/selectivity/quality requirements pass. This remains development evidence, not untouched confirmation.
descriptors: Report every family, item, label, length and method. Use the fixed selected component and training orientation. Compute target-minus-control oriented coefficient and physical-gradient cosine within item/length. Require positive means and at least 6/8 positive pairs at each length, retaining zero codes and failures. Cross-family results test specificity.
quality: For each selected direction, use all 40 controlled prompts. Compute signed target and every off-target detector response across all strengths. Also report own-family and all-family strata. Compare each signed condition to the common baseline for content, truncation, degeneration and length. Compute positive-part harm per condition before averaging; never let improvements cancel damage. Report worst condition. Narrow content check is not general semantic correctness.
bootstrap: 1000 fixed-seed paired bootstrap draws, seed2026101421. Resample published prompts within family and inviting/control stratum, retaining methods/signs/strengths. Resample controlled item indices within family, retaining labels and lengths for descriptors and all conditions for steering. Report pointwise95% intervals and99% Bonferroni intervals for five family comparisons. No broad two-seed population inference.
complete_reporting: Report all500 candidates per method, training purity/coherence distribution, selected top documents and selection rationale, reconstruction and active coefficient counts, every family/condition/seed/quality endpoint. Training coherence is descriptive. No best-strength selection. SVD is uncentered randomized rank500, not PCA or SVD of learned atoms.
fixed_examples: First five inviting and first five control published prompts per family, and all40 controlled prompts, for baseline and all applicable signed strengths/methods. Greedy sample0 only.
audit: Verify source/input/selection/descriptor/output hashes, selection lock before any descriptor/generation, full101-condition/14540-response/160-descriptor grid per seed, every exact adapter restore and original deadlines. Compare both method norm matching and full candidate budget. Archive source before remote checkout changes.
barrier: Both seeds of this track must finish or reach their original deadlines before any held-out output reading.
